basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 25-year-old outdoor enthusiast from the Midwest, currently living in Iowa. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for hiking and exploring with my trusty Subaru Outback. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends, especially when I'm planning my next adventure. Not a big fan of city life, I prefer the tranquility of nature. I'm single and enjoying the freedom that comes with it!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm quite knowledgeable about cars, especially Subaru models, thanks to years of tinkering and joining local car meetups. My design skills are self-taught, honed through online courses and lots of practice. I'm also a bit of a tech enthusiast, keeping up with the latest gadget news.
